arxiv-1503-03270.title: A Novel Hybrid CNN-AIS Visual Pattern Recognition Engine
arxiv-1503-03270.creator: Vandna Bhalla, Santanu Chaudhury, Arihant Jain
arxiv-1503-03270.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Vandna Bhalla, Santanu Chaudhury, Arihant Jain. Machine learning methods are used today for most recognition problems. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have time and again proved successful for many image processing tasks primarily for their architecture. In this paper we propose to apply CNN to small data sets like for example, personal albums or other similar environs where the size of training dataset is a limitation, within the framework of a proposed hybrid CNN-AIS model.

arxiv-2206-04658.title: BigVGAN: A Universal Neural Vocoder with Large-Scale Training
arxiv-2206-04658.creator: Sang-gil Lee Wei Ping, Boris Ginsburg Bryan Catanzaro Sungroh Yoon
arxiv-2206-04658.description: Abstract Despite recent progress in generative adversarial network (GAN)-based vocoders, where the model generates raw waveform conditioned on acoustic features, it is challenging to synthesize high-fidelity audio for numerous speakers across various recording environments. In this work, we present BigVGAN, a universal vocoder that generalizes well for various out-of-distribution scenarios without fine-tuning.

arxiv-2212-00622.title: Vertical Federated Learning: A Structured Literature Review
arxiv-2212-00622.creator: Afsana Khan, Marijn ten Thij, Anna Wilbik
arxiv-2212-00622.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising distributed learning paradigm with an added advantage of data privacy. With the growing interest in having collaboration among data owners, FL has gained significant attention of organizations. The idea of FL is to enable collaborating participants train machine learning (ML) models on decentralized data without breaching privacy.

arxiv-2303-00755.title: Cloud K-SVD for Image Denoising
arxiv-2303-00755.creator: Christian Marius Lillelund https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2520-3774, Henrik Bagger Jensen, Christian Fischer Pedersen https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1266-5857
arxiv-2303-00755.description: Abstract Cloud K-SVD is a dictionary learning algorithm that can train at multiple nodes and hereby produce a mutual dictionary to represent low-dimensional geometric structures in image data. We present a novel application of the algorithm as we use it to recover both noiseless and noisy images from overlapping patches.

arxiv-2306-15569.title: Enhancing the purity of single photons in parametric down-conversion through simultaneous pump-beam and crystal-domain engineering
arxiv-2306-15569.creator: Baghdasar Baghdasaryan, Fabian Steinlechner, Stephan Fritzsche
arxiv-2306-15569.description: Abstract Spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) has shown great promise in the generation of pure and indistinguishable single photons. Photon pairs produced in bulk crystals are highly correlated in terms of transverse space and frequency. These correlations limit the indistinguishability of photons and result in inefficient photon sources.

arxiv-2311-12357.title: Electrodynamics with violations of Lorentz and U(1) gauge symmetries and their Hamiltonian structure
arxiv-2311-12357.creator: Xiu-Peng Yang a,b, Bao-Fei Li a,b, Tao Zhu a,b
arxiv-2311-12357.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiu-Peng Yang a,b, Bao-Fei Li a,b, Tao Zhu a,b. This article aims to study the Lorentz/U(1) gauge symmetry-breaking electrodynamics in the framework of the Standard-Model Extension and analyze the Hamiltonian structure for the theory with a specific dimension d ≤ 4 d\leq 4 of Lorentz breaking operators. For this purpose, we consider a general quadratic action of the modified electrodynamics with Lorentz/gauge-breaking operators and calculate the number of independent components of the operators at different dimensions in gauge invariance and breaking.

arxiv-2312-11276.title: Compositional Generalization for Multi-label Text Classification: A Data-Augmentation Approach
arxiv-2312-11276.creator: Yuyang Chai, Zhuang Li, Jiahui Liu, Lei Chen, Fei Li, Donghong Ji, Chong Teng
arxiv-2312-11276.description: Abstract Despite significant advancements in multi-label text classification, the ability of existing models to generalize to novel and seldom-encountered complex concepts, which are compositions of elementary ones, remains underexplored. This research addresses this gap. By creating unique data splits across three benchmarks, we assess the compositional generalization ability of existing multi-label text classification models.

arxiv-2403-15642.creator: François Delarue, Mattia Martini
arxiv-2403-15642.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by François Delarue, Mattia Martini. The purpose of this work is to provide a finite dimensional approximation of the solution to a mean field optimal control problem set on the d d -dimensional torus. The approximation is obtained by means of a Fourier-Galerkin method, the main principle of which is to convolve probability measures on the torus by the Dirichlet kernel or, equivalently, to truncate the Fourier expansion of probability measures on the torus.

arxiv-2407-05874.title: Investigating Trading Mechanisms as a Driver for User Experience in Racing Games PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-5067-8/24/$31.00 ©2024 IEEE
arxiv-2407-05874.creator: Georg Arbesser-Rastburg, Thomas Olip, Johanna Pirker
arxiv-2407-05874.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Georg Arbesser-Rastburg, Thomas Olip, Johanna Pirker. The exchange of digital goods has become a significant aspect of the global economy, with digital products offering inexpensive reproduction and distribution. In-game objects, a type of digital currency, have emerged as tradable commodities within gaming ecosystems. Despite extensive research on various aspects of digital goods, little attention has been given to the impact of in-game trading mechanisms on user experience.

arxiv-2408-01635.title: KTWIN: A Serverless Kubernetes-based Digital Twin Platform
arxiv-2408-01635.creator: Alexandre Gustavo Wermann, Juliano Araujo Wickboldt
arxiv-2408-01635.description: Abstract Digital Twins ( DTs ) systems are virtual representations of physical assets allowing organizations to gain insights and improve existing processes. In practice, DTs require proper modeling, coherent development and seamless deployment along cloud and edge landscapes relying on established patterns to reduce operational costs. In this work, we propose KTWIN a Kubernetes-based Serverless Platform for Digital Twins.

arxiv-2410-11916.title: "The Simplest Idea One Can Have" for Seamless Forecasts with Postprocessing
arxiv-2410-11916.creator: Markus Dabernig, Aitor Atencia
arxiv-2410-11916.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Markus Dabernig, Aitor Atencia. Seamless forecasts are based on a combination of different sources to produce the best possible forecasts. Statistical multimodel postprocessing helps to combine various sources to achieve these seamless forecasts. However, when one of the combined sources of the forecast is not available due to reaching the end of its forecasting horizon, forecasts can be temporally inconsistent and sudden drops in skill can be observed.

arxiv-2509-01587.creator: Maciej Krzysztof Zuziak maciejkrzysztof.zuziak@isti.cnr.it, Roberto Pellungrini roberto.pellungrini@sns.it, Salvatore Rinzivillo rinzivillo@isti.cnr.it
arxiv-2509-01587.description: Abstract fl ( fl ) is a widespread and well-adopted paradigm of decentralised learning that allows training one model from multiple sources without the need to transfer data between participating clients directly. Since its inception in 2015, it has been divided into numerous subfields that deal with application-specific issues, such as data heterogeneity or resource allocation.

arxiv-2510-15360.title: Friction-controlled reentrant aging and fluidization in granular materials
arxiv-2510-15360.creator: Ye Yuan, Walter Kob, Hajime Tanaka
arxiv-2510-15360.description: Abstract Granular materials densify under repeated mechanical perturbations, a nonequilibrium dynamics that underlies many natural and industrial processes. Because granular relaxation is governed by frictional contacts and energy dissipation, this aging behavior fundamentally differs from that of thermal glasses despite their apparent similarities. Here, we uncover how friction controls the compaction dynamics of granular packings subjected to cyclic shear.

arxiv-2601-12287.title: Open charm production and Λ c + / D 0 \Lambda_{c}^{+}/D^{0} ratio in pp and Au+Au collisions at the RHIC
arxiv-2601-12287.creator: Bijun Fan, Chao Zhang, Liang Zheng, Shusu Shi
arxiv-2601-12287.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Bijun Fan, Chao Zhang, Liang Zheng, Shusu Shi. We study open charm hadrons production in pp and Au+Au collisions at s NN = 200 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=200 GeV using an improved a multi-phase transport (AMPT) model. Specifically, we show the transverse-momentum spectra and nuclear modification factors R AA R_{\mathrm{AA}} of D 0 D^{0} mesons and Λ c + \Lambda_{c}^{+} baryons, as well as the Λ c + / D 0 \Lambda_{c}^{+}/D^{0} ratio in pp and Au+Au collisions.

arxiv-2601-20897.title: Missing digits and sums of two prime squares
arxiv-2601-20897.creator: Cihan Sabuncu
arxiv-2601-20897.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Cihan Sabuncu. We investigate integers whose base g g expansion omits a fixed digit and which can be represented as a sum of two prime squares. In the first part of the paper, we apply the Hardy–Littlewood circle method to obtain asymptotic formulas for weighted count of representations of such integers up to g k g^{k} as k → ∞ k\to\infty , where we weight by the von Mangoldt function.

arxiv-2602-07787.title: Do Multi-Agents Dream of Electric Screens? Achieving Perfect Accuracy on AndroidWorld Through Task Decomposition
arxiv-2602-07787.creator: Pierre-Louis Favreau, Jean-Pierre Lo, Clement Guiguet, Charles Simon-Meunier, Nicolas Dehandschoewercker, Allen G. Roush, Judah Goldfeder, Ravid Shwartz-Ziv
arxiv-2602-07787.description: Abstract We present Minitap’s mobile-use, a multi-agent system that achieves 100% success on the AndroidWorld benchmark, the first to fully solve all 116 tasks and surpassing human performance (80%). We first analyze why single-agent architectures fail: context pollution from mixed reasoning traces, silent text input failures undetected by the agent, and repetitive action loops without escape.

Genomic SELEX transforms SELEX into a tool to discover novel, genomically encoded RNA or DNA sequences binding a ligand of interest, called genom

pmc-10540338.title: Multi-omics revealed the long-term effect of ruminal keystone bacteria and the microbial metabolome on lactation performance in adult dairy goats
pmc-10540338.creator: Dangdang Wang, Luyu Chen, Guangfu Tang, Junjian Yu, Jie Chen, Zongjun Li, Yangchun Cao, Xinjian Lei, Lu Deng, Shengru Wu, Le Luo Guan, Junhu Yao
pmc-10540338.description: BackgroundThe increased growth rate of young animals can lead to higher lactation performance in adult goats; however, the effects of the ruminal microbiome on the growth of young goats, and the contribution of the early-life rumen microbiome to lifelong growth and lactation performance in goats has not yet been well defined.

pmc-10605637.title: Lactation Support as a Proxy Measure of Family-Centered Care Quality in Neonates with Life-Limiting Conditions—A Comparative Study
pmc-10605637.creator: Suneeta Brito, Allison Williams, Jenny Fox, Tazuddin Mohammed, Nayef Chahin, Kaitlin McCarthy, Lamisa Nubayaat, Shirley Nunlist, Mason Brannon, Jie Xu, Karen D Hendricks-Muñoz, Daniele Trevisanuto
pmc-10605637.description: Background: Lactation support is an important measure of Family-Centered Care (FCC) in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). Life-limiting conditions (LLCs) raise complex ethical care issues for providers and parents in the NICU and represent a key and often overlooked population for whom FCC is particularly important. We investigated healthcare disparities in FCC lactation support quality in infants with LLCs.

pmc-11387570.title: Health concerns, access to care, and trust in research and researchers among community members with bipolar disorder
pmc-11387570.creator: Christian Conger, Linda B. Cottler
pmc-11387570.description: BackgroundData are needed on differences in community-dwelling populations with bipolar disorder (BP) regarding trust in research and access to care. We characterized community members by lifetime history of bipolar disorder. We hypothesized that those with BP would have less trust in research, visit a health provider less, and participate less in research than those without BP.

pmc-11454405.title: 12555 Stress Fractures In A Military Population Across Different Career Stages
pmc-11454405.creator: Andrew Joseph Spiro, Mohamed K M Shakir, Thanh Duc Hoang
pmc-11454405.description: Disclosure: A.J. Spiro: None. M.K. Shakir: None. T.D. Hoang: None.Stress fractures are overuse injuries that occur in people with normal bones in the absence of an acute injury. They tend to occur in individuals who are beginning new or more intense physical activity and affect military personnel at higher rates than the general population.

pmc-11487922.title: Number of involved nodal stations predicts survival in small cell lung cancer
pmc-11487922.creator: Han Zhang, Cong Jiang, Dongliang Bian, Jing Zhang, Yuming Zhu, Jie Dai, Gening Jiang
pmc-11487922.description: BackgroundIn small cell lung cancer (SCLC), the pathological N category is identical to it in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and remains unchanged over a decade. Here we verified the discriminability of number of involved nodal stations (nS) in SCLC and compared its efficacy in predicting survival with currently used pathological nodal (pN) staging.

pmc-11649618.title: Green synthesis and multifaceted applications: challenges and innovations in carbon dot nanocomposites
pmc-11649618.creator: S Varadharajan, Kirthanashri S Vasanthan, Vidhi Mathur, N Hariperumal, Nirmal Mazumder
pmc-11649618.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper describes the potential of carbon dot nanocomposites (CDs) synthesized from waste materials by top-down and bottom-up state-of-the-art approaches. Through sustainable practices, wastes are converted into valuable nanomaterials, solving environmental problems and pioneering advances in nanotechnology. In this paper, an overview of the synthesis aspects of CDs is presented with the formation of their versatile nanocomposites and metal/metal oxide elements.

pmc-12444252.title: Towards comprehensive care in crush syndrome: Expanding the multidisciplinary framework
pmc-12444252.creator: Luca Galassi, Federica Facchinetti
pmc-12444252.description: Crush syndrome demands an integrated multidisciplinary approach that spans acute surgical decisions and long-term functional recovery. In response to Khan et al’s recent systematic review, we propose complementary perspectives that address two underrepresented dimensions: Vascular surgical decision-making and psychiatric rehabilitation.

pmc-12643307.title: Variability in the utilization of preventive dental services among the underserved population of Indiana
pmc-12643307.creator: Anubhuti Shukla, Bhavya Vaishnavi Amrutham, Sheetal Manchanda
pmc-12643307.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesTo explore the variability of utilization patterns of preventive dental services among diverse demographic groups in the state of Indiana.MethodsThis study utilizes a retrospective data analysis approach to examine the preventive dental services utilization among patients treated by senior-year dental students (D4 students) during their community-based clinical rotations at Federally Qualified Health Centers and private practices, affiliated with Indiana University School of Dentistry.

pmc-12653148.title: Stability Challenges and Non-Target Effects of Mandelonitrile-Based Sugar Baits for Leishmaniasis Vector Control
pmc-12653148.creator: Camila J Pereira-Pinto, Jean P S Costa, Juliana Welbert, João P D Simoni, Gabriel S Thomaz, Ana C V Faria, Sergio M Correa, Bruno Gomes, Fernando A Genta, Thomas Walker
pmc-12653148.description: Simple SummaryLeishmaniasis is a disease spread by tiny insects called sand flies. Since there is no vaccine and treatment can be difficult, scientists are exploring new ways to stop the insects from spreading the disease. One promising method is using sugar baits—sweet solutions that attract sand flies and contain substances that can kill the parasite or shorten the insect’s life.

pmc-12654354.title: Plug and Play Multi-Organ Chips: Integrated µGaskets for the Facile and Reversible Connection of Individual Organ-on-Chip Modules
pmc-12654354.creator: Hannah Graf, Martin Gaier, Caroline Culp, Peter Loskill, Nam-Trung Nguyen
pmc-12654354.description: Multi-organ-chip (MOC) models provide a plethora of auspicious opportunities to replace current in vitro and in vivo models for a more systemic investigation of human (patho-)physiology for drug development and personalized medicine. Integration of individual organ tissues into a systemic circulation remains a major challenge for their implementation/application.

pmc-13602594.title: Intimate partner violence during pregnancy in sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13602594.creator: Richard Gyan Aboagye, Husna Razee, Nuworza Kugbey, Blessing Jaka Akombi-Inyang
pmc-13602594.description: BackgroundIntimate partner violence (IPV) has health and human rights implications for victim-survivors. During pregnancy, IPV is associated with several morbidities, injuries, and mortality among women and their foetuses. Identifying the prevalence and factors associated with IPV during pregnancy is crucial towards developing preventive strategies to curb its occurrence.

pmc-13651161.title: Decoding the shared genetic architecture of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: a genomic structural equation modeling analysis
pmc-13651161.creator: Danfeng Zhong, Yaping Ye, Tingting Ye, Shishi Jin
pmc-13651161.description: BackgroundAtherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) represents a broad spectrum of phenotypes with shared pathology. However, the joint genetic architecture across different vascular beds remains incompletely characterized.MethodsWe applied genomic structural equation modeling (Genomic SEM) to integrate GWAS summary statistics from six ASCVD-related traits: coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, peripheral artery disease, carotid intima-media thickness, and intracranial aneurysm.
